module.purpose: Implements an outdated React Suspense cache that creates resources with read/preload backed by an LRU, throwing thenables/errors for Suspense and supporting a global cache limit.
module.summary: This module provides a legacy caching utility for React Suspense. It exposes a factory to create cache resources that wrap an async fetch function, storing pending, resolved, and rejected outcomes in a shared LRU keyed by resource and hashed input. The read method throws a suspender while pending or an error if rejected, and returns the value once resolved; preload warms the cache. Dev-mode validation warns on non-primitive cache keys. A global cache limit can be adjusted at runtime.
module.businessContext: Powers internal React data-fetch caching for Suspense. Failure breaks suspended component data loading and cache eviction behavior.

detail.signature: export function unstable_createResource<I, K: string | number, V>(fetch: I => Thenable<V>, maybeHashInput?: I => K): Resource<I, V>
preconditions: fetch must be a function returning a Thenable<V>
maybeHashInput if provided must be a function returning string | number
postconditions: Returns an object (Resource<I, V>) with read(input: I): V and preload(input: I): void methods
The returned resource uses the provided maybeHashInput or defaults to identityHashFn for key hashing
edgeCases: maybeHashInput undefined => hashInput assigned to identityHashFn
detail.summary: Creates a cache resource object that wraps an async fetch function and optional hash, exposing read and preload methods to suspend on and cache results keyed by hashed input.

units.name: read

detail.name: read
preconditions: The input must be hashable by the configured hashInput function (defaulting to identityHashFn).
A CacheContext must be available in the current React render context (read via readContext).
The associated fetch function must be defined and compatible with the input type I.
postconditions: If the result is Resolved, the cached value of type V is returned synchronously.
If the result is Pending, the suspender (a thenable) is thrown to trigger React Suspense.
If the result is Rejected, the error stored in the result is thrown.
The result is retrieved via accessResult with the resource, fetch, input, and hashed key.
invariants: The resource object remains stable across calls; read operations do not mutate the resource itself.
The hashed key is derived consistently from the same input using the same hashInput function.
The returned value conforms to type V when the status is Resolved.
edgeCases: Pending status: throws the suspender thenable to defer rendering until resolved.
Resolved status: returns the cached value directly.
Rejected status: throws the error stored in the result.
Context access: always reads CacheContext even if unused internally, to enforce usage outside render.
Null or undefined input: depends on hashInput behavior; identityHashFn would return as-is.
stateMutations: Reads from the global cache via accessResult.
May trigger cache initialization or updates within accessResult.
detail.summary: Reads a cached resource value for the given input, suspending or throwing based on the resolution status of the underlying async result.
